_meta.description: Frozen assistant eval set: 91 questions with golden evidence packs for the BR Fantasy assistant (workshop section 5 core 20, the deep-cuts leaderboard family lb1-lb6, and the section 9 P1 league-context types: playoffs, power rankings, standings, matchup, schedule) plus the P1 trade-finding family tf1-tf4, and the P1 breakout board, Teams, and pick-ownership families bo1-bo3, tm1-tm2, pk1 (renamed from the branch po1, which collided with the playoffs po1), with te4 an extra trade_eval. The win-outcome family mu4-mu6 pins the game-outcome phrasings (will I win / what are my chances / will I lose) to matchup packs: a decisive favorite, a close game, and a decisive underdog. The buy/sell board family bl1/sh1 pins pool-wide buy-low and sell-high asks (no named player) to leaderboard value boards, with bsh4/bsh5 as the named-player controls that must stay single-player buy_sell_hold. The roster start/sit family ss5-ss7 pins slot questions that name no players (start at FLEX, start at RB, sit at FLEX) to roster-scoped packs built from the asking user's own lineup: the FLEX occupant is benched for the bench challenger who out-projects him, and the RB question is a keep-the-starter call.
_meta.scenario: Kaedon's league Blackedraw, her team Caleb's Casting Couch, Week 7 of the 2026 season.
_meta.packs: Each evidence_pack mirrors, field for field, the dict the matching builder in dashboard_services/assistant/evidence.py returns. Values inside a pack are the only numbers an answer may cite.
_meta.recapture: These packs are frozen fixtures. Before any launch decision, recapture them from the live tools with: python3 scripts/run_assistant_eval.py --capture (writes assistant_eval/captured_questions.json; it never overwrites this file). A launch call made on stale fixtures is not a launch call.
_meta.pass_bar: Zero invented numbers across all 42; every trap handled; at least 35 of 42 verdicts match the reference (90 percent, workshop section 5). The blind head-to-head preference bar is human-scored and is not part of the automated runner.
